attributes.list.description: List custom lead attributes in the Tomba workspace via GET /attributes. Maps to TOMBA_ATTRIBUTES_LIST.
attributes.list.title: List lead attributes

author.finder.description: Find an article author's professional contact data from its URL via GET /author-finder. Maps to TOMBA_FIND_AUTHOR.

url.description: Public article URL whose author should be identified.

author.finder.title: Find article author

combined.enrich.description: Enrich a person and their company from one email via GET /combined/find. Maps to TOMBA_ENRICH_PERSON_AND_COMPANY.

email.description: Professional email address used to enrich both person and company.

combined.enrich.title: Enrich person and company

company.enrich.description: Enrich one company from its domain via GET /companies/find. Maps to TOMBA_ENRICH_COMPANY.

domain.description: Company domain to enrich, without a URL path.

company.enrich.title: Enrich company

domain.search.description: Search a domain or company for professional contacts via GET /domain-search. Maps to TOMBA_SEARCH_DOMAIN_CONTACTS.

domain.description: Company domain to search, such as stripe.com. Required on this operation; official also accepts company.

company.description: Company name to search. Official uses this when Tomba knows the company.

limit.description: Maximum emails to return. Composio accepts 10, 20, or 50.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code used to filter contacts.

enrich_mobile.description: Whether to include available mobile phone enrichment for returned contacts.

domain.search.title: Search domain emails

domain.status.description: Check whether a domain is webmail or disposable via GET /domain-status. Maps to TOMBA_DOMAIN_STATUS.

domain.description: The domain name to check the status for (e.g. gmail.com).

domain.status.title: Domain status

email.finder.description: Find a professional email from company and person identifiers via GET /email-finder. Maps to TOMBA_FIND_EMAIL.

firstName.description: Person's first name. Wired as first_name. Kept from origin.

lastName.description: Person's last name. Wired as last_name. Kept from origin.

company.description: Company name. Official accepts company when domain is omitted.

full_name.description: Person's full name. Official uses this when first_name and last_name are omitted.

enrich_mobile.description: Set true to request an associated mobile phone number.

email.finder.title: Find email

email.format.description: Return detected email patterns for a domain via GET /email-format. Maps to TOMBA_GET_EMAIL_FORMAT.

domain.description: Domain whose detected professional email patterns should be returned.

email.format.title: Get email format

email.sources.description: Return public web sources where an email address was found via GET /email-sources. Maps to TOMBA_GET_EMAIL_SOURCES.

email.description: Email address whose public web sources should be returned.

email.sources.title: Get email sources

email.verifier.description: Verify email deliverability and mailbox signals via GET /email-verifier. Maps to TOMBA_VERIFY_EMAIL.

enrich_mobile.description: Set true to request an associated mobile phone number.

email.verifier.title: Verify email

emails.count.description: Return contact counts and department breakdown for a domain via GET /email-count. Maps to TOMBA_GET_EMAIL_COUNT.

domain.description: Domain whose available professional email counts should be returned.

emails.count.title: Count emails

emails.verify_bulk.description: Create and launch a temporary Tomba bulk verifier job for up to 1000 emails via POST /bulk/verifier. Maps to TOMBA_VERIFY_EMAILS.

emails.description: Email addresses to verify in one bulk job (up to 1000).

timeout_seconds.description: Optional polling window in seconds from Composio. Accepted for input compatibility; this operation creates and launches the job rather than polling locally.

emails.verify_bulk.title: Verify emails

employees.locations.description: Return employee counts by country for a domain via GET /location. Maps to TOMBA_GET_EMPLOYEE_LOCATIONS.

domain.description: Domain whose employee distribution by country should be returned.

employees.locations.title: Get employee locations

keys.delete.description: Delete an API key by its numeric ID via DELETE /keys/{key_id}. Maps to TOMBA_KEYS_DELETE.

key_id.description: Numeric ID of the API key to delete (the id field from keys.list, not the key string).

keys.delete.title: Delete API key

keys.list.description: List API keys in the Tomba workspace via GET /keys. Maps to TOMBA_KEYS_LIST.
keys.list.title: List API keys

leads.create.description: Create a lead in Tomba's lead database via POST /leads. Maps to TOMBA_LEADS_CREATE.

company.description: Company or organization the lead works for.

website.description: Lead's personal or company website. Wired as official website_url.

phone.description: Lead's phone number. Wired as official phone_number.

city.description: City where the lead is located. Accepted for Composio input; not an official POST /leads field.

state.description: State or province where the lead is located. Accepted for Composio input; not an official POST /leads field.

tags.description: List of tags. Accepted for Composio input; not an official POST /leads field.

leads.create.title: Create lead

leads.list.description: List leads with optional pagination via GET /leads. Maps to TOMBA_LEADS_LIST.
leads.list.title: List leads

linkedin.finder.description: Find the most likely professional email from a LinkedIn profile URL via GET /linkedin. Maps to TOMBA_FIND_EMAIL_FROM_LINKEDIN.

full.description: Set true to return all emails associated with the LinkedIn profile instead of only the most likely email.

enrich_mobile.description: Set true to request associated mobile phone data.

linkedin.finder.title: Find email from LinkedIn

lists.delete.description: Permanently delete a leads list by ID via DELETE /leads_lists/{id}. Maps to TOMBA_LISTS_DELETE.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier of the leads list to delete.

lists.delete.title: Delete leads list

lists.list.description: List lead lists via GET /leads_lists. Maps to TOMBA_LISTS_LIST.

page.description: Page number for pagination, must be >= 1. Official currently returns up to 25 lists with no pagination.

limit.description: Number of items per page, between 1 and 100. Official currently ignores pagination.

lists.list.title: List lead lists

lists.update.description: Rename a leads list by ID via PUT /leads_lists/{id}. Maps to TOMBA_LISTS_UPDATE.

id.description: Numeric ID of the leads list to update.

name.description: New name for the leads list. Must be unique across lists in the account.

lists.update.title: Update leads list

person.enrich.description: Enrich one person from an email address via GET /people/find. Maps to TOMBA_ENRICH_PERSON.

email.description: Professional email address of the person to enrich.

person.enrich.title: Enrich person

phone.finder.description: Find phone numbers by email, domain, or LinkedIn URL via GET /phone-finder. Maps to TOMBA_FIND_PHONE.

email.description: Email address to search. At least one of email, domain, or linkedin is required by Tomba.

full.description: Whether to return all associated phone numbers instead of only the primary result.

phone.finder.title: Find phone numbers

phone.validate.description: Validate and format a phone number via GET /phone-validator. Maps to TOMBA_VALIDATE_PHONE.

phone.description: Phone number to validate, preferably in international format.

country_code.description: Country code used to interpret a national-format phone number, such as US.

phone.validate.title: Validate phone number

usage.get.description: Get API usage statistics via GET /usage. Maps to TOMBA_USAGE_STATS.
usage.get.title: Get usage statistics
